facts.fact: Raxio Group's CTO says the CIV1 data centre in Abidjan, inaugurated September 2024, is fed by two independent (N+N) 15kV feeders sourced directly from the CIE substation, each able to carry 100% of the load.

CIV.note: No PUE figure or water use is stated; power set aside for data centres generally is not stated.

facts.fact: African Review reports that Raxio Group's CIV1 in Abidjan, inaugurated September 2024, is the country's first Tier III certified carrier-neutral and cloud-neutral data centre.

CIV.note: Only one Tier III facility is named; no cloud region is stated.
The document says CIV1 'will also serve as host' to CIVIX, which states no networks exchanging traffic in service.
The document says nothing about local government.
The document does not state who owns CIV1 beyond naming Raxio Group as operator, so no national ownership is stated.
